Black Sees Nvidia as Undervalued Despite Strong Growth Outlook
On Wednesday, Black took to
X

to highlight Nvidia’s valuation, noting that the stock trades at a forward price-to-earnings multiple of 8.9 times and an enterprise value-to-EBITDA multiple of 7.3 times, both reportedly their lowest levels in at least 10 years.

He contrasted those multiples with Nvidia’s projected long-term revenue growth of 25% and earnings-per-share growth of 28%, arguing that its growth-adjusted valuation stands out among mega-cap companies.
"Fundamentally for NVDA, nothing much has changed – there has been no earnings or revenue degradation in recent weeks," he wrote.
